rationale: Vamsi brings hands-on full-stack development experience across NLP and computer vision projects, while Matt leads AI infrastructure and agentic AI initiatives at the Linux Foundation and UC Berkeley. They both work in Python and share ML-adjacent domains—Vamsi's applied ML projects and Matt's infrastructure-level focus on AI systems represent complementary perspectives on building and scaling intelligent applications.
intro_message: Vamsi Krishna N K, meet Matt White — you're both deep in the Python/ML ecosystem, and Matt's work on agentic AI infrastructure could offer valuable context for the kinds of systems you're building at Google.
